tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The D CORE 1U 19in X10RM Industrial Server Rack Mount Black Case is a compact and reliable chassis designed for professional server and networking environments. Built to fit standard 19-inch server racks, this 1U rackmount server case is ideal for data centers, network appliances, firewall systems, and industrial computing applications.


Constructed with high-quality steel and a durable black finish, the X10RM rackmount chassis ensures long-lasting performance and stability. Its space-saving 1U design allows efficient use of rack space while maintaining proper airflow for system cooling. The case supports multiple motherboard form factors, making it suitable for building custom servers, routers, and storage systems.


Designed for system integrators and enterprise deployments, the D CORE X10RM 1U rackmount case offers strong construction, efficient ventilation, and easy installation in standard server cabinets.


Key Features


  • Standard 1U 19-inch rackmount server chassis
  • Compact X10 depth design suitable for network cabinets
  • Heavy-duty steel construction with black industrial coating
  • Supports ATX / Micro-ATX / Mini-ITX motherboards
  • Front panel power and reset buttons
  • LED indicators for power and HDD status
  • Optimized airflow design for cooling
  • Supports PCI/PCIe expansion via riser card
  • Compatible with 1U power supply
  • Ideal for server, firewall, router, and network appliance systems
